project_description: Make developer-facing Make, build, lint, test, parity, backend-plugin, QA, and release-support tasks reliable and bounded on Windows 10 without weakening Linux CI, release, security, conformance, fuzz, or race evidence. The specification covers cross-platform command execution and cleanup, Windows-safe environment routing, bounded nested module checks, deterministic ACP lookup concurrency evidence, SQLite-only busy retries with cancellation, and truthful unsupported-platform skip semantics.
